verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֧ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַנָּבִ֖יא עַל־ הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer hā·yāh ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî ‘al- hag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: This is the word of the LORD about the nations the word that came to Jeremiah the prophet
verses.literalPt: A palavra de Jeová que veio a Jeremias, o profeta, acerca das nações.

verses.original: לְמִצְרַ֗יִם עַל־ חֵ֨יל פַּרְעֹ֤ה נְכוֹ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁר־ הָיָ֥ה עַל־ נְהַר־ פְּרָ֖ת בְּכַרְכְּמִ֑שׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִכָּ֗ה נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל בִּשְׁנַת֙ הָֽרְבִיעִ֔ית לִיהוֹיָקִ֥ים בֶּן־ יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lə·miṣ·ra·yim ‘al- ḥêl par·‘ōh nə·ḵōw me·leḵ miṣ·ra·yim ’ă·šer- hā·yāh ‘al- nə·har- pə·rāṯ bə·ḵar·kə·miš ’ă·šer hik·kāh nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar me·leḵ bā·ḇel biš·naṯ hā·rə·ḇî·‘îṯ lî·hō·w·yā·qîm ben- yō·šî·yā·hū me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: concerning Egypt and the army of Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt which . . . . . . was defeated at Carchemish on the Euphrates River by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah
verses.literalPt: A respeito do Egito; acerca do exército de Faraó-Neco, rei do Egito, que estava junto ao rio Eufrates em Carquemis, ao qual Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia, derrotou no quarto ano de Jeoaquim, filho de Josias, rei de Judá.

verses.original: עִרְכ֤וּ מָגֵן֙ וְצִנָּ֔ה וּגְשׁ֖וּ לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ir·ḵū mā·ḡên wə·ṣin·nāh ū·ḡə·šū lam·mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: Deploy your shields, small and large advance for battle
verses.literalPt: Preparai o escudo e o pavês, e chegai-vos para pelejar.

verses.original: אִסְר֣וּ הַסּוּסִ֗ים וַֽעֲלוּ֙ הַפָּ֣רָשִׁ֔ים וְהִֽתְיַצְּב֖וּ בְּכ֥וֹבָעִ֑ים מִרְקוּ֙ הָֽרְמָחִ֔ים לִבְשׁ֖וּ הַסִּרְיֹנֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ’is·rū has·sū·sîm wa·‘ă·lū hap·pā·rā·šîm wə·hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣə·ḇū bə·ḵō·w·ḇā·‘îm mir·qū hā·rə·mā·ḥîm liḇ·šū has·sir·yō·nōṯ
verses.literal: Harness the horses mount the steeds take your positions with helmets on Polish your spears put on armor
verses.literalPt: Aparelhai os cavalos, montai nos ginetes, e apresentai-vos com elmos; açacalai lanças, vesti-vos de couraças.

verses.original: מַדּ֣וּעַ רָאִ֗יתִי הֵ֣מָּה חַתִּים֮ נְסֹגִ֣ים אָחוֹר֒ וְגִבּוֹרֵיהֶ֣ם יֻכַּ֔תּוּ וּמָנ֥וֹס נָ֖סוּ וְלֹ֣א הִפְנ֑וּ מָג֥וֹר מִסָּבִ֖יב נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mad·dū·a‘ rā·’î·ṯî hêm·māh ḥat·tîm nə·sō·ḡîm ’ā·ḥō·wr wə·ḡib·bō·w·rê·hem yuk·kat·tū ū·mā·nō·ws nā·sū wə·lō hip̄·nū mā·ḡō·wr mis·sā·ḇîḇ nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Why am I seeing this? They are terrified they are retreating . . . their warriors are defeated they flee in haste without looking back terror is on every side declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Por que tenho esta visão? eles se espantam e voltam para trás; os seus valentes são derrotados e fogem precipitados: terror há por todos os lados, diz Jeová.

verses.original: אַל־ יָנ֣וּס הַקַּ֔ל וְאַל־ יִמָּלֵ֖ט הַגִּבּ֑וֹר צָפ֙וֹנָה֙ עַל־ יַ֣ד נְהַר־ פְּרָ֔ת כָּשְׁל֖וּ וְנָפָֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- yā·nūs haq·qal wə·’al- yim·mā·lêṭ hag·gib·bō·wr ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh ‘al- yaḏ nə·har- pə·rāṯ kā·šə·lū wə·nā·p̄ā·lū
verses.literal: The swift cannot flee and the warrior cannot escape In the north by . . . the River Euphrates they stumble and fall
verses.literalPt: Não fuja o ligeiro, nem escape o valente; à banda do norte junto ao rio Eufrates tropeçaram e caíram.

verses.original: מִי־ זֶ֖ה כַּיְאֹ֣ר יַֽעֲלֶ֑ה כַּנְּהָר֕וֹת יִֽתְגָּעֲשׁ֖וּ מֵימָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: mî- zeh kay·’ōr ya·‘ă·leh kan·nə·hā·rō·wṯ yiṯ·gā·‘ă·šū mê·māw
verses.literal: Who is this rising like the Nile like rivers whose waters churn
verses.literalPt: Quem é este que sobe como o Nilo, cujas águas se agitam como os rios?

verses.original: מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ כַּיְאֹ֣ר יַֽעֲלֶ֔ה וְכַנְּהָר֖וֹת יִתְגֹּ֣עֲשׁוּ מָ֑יִם וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אַֽעֲלֶה֙ אֲכַסֶּה־ אֶ֔רֶץ אֹבִ֥ידָה עִ֖יר וְיֹ֥שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: miṣ·ra·yim kay·’ōr ya·‘ă·leh wə·ḵan·nə·hā·rō·wṯ yiṯ·gō·‘ă·šū mā·yim way·yō·mer ’a·‘ă·leh ’ă·ḵas·seh- ’e·reṣ ’ō·ḇî·ḏāh ‘îr wə·yō·šə·ḇê ḇāh
verses.literal: Egypt rises like the Nile and its waters churn like rivers boasting I will rise and cover the earth I will destroy the cities and their people
verses.literalPt: O Egito sobe como o Nilo, e as suas águas agitam-se como os rios; e diz: Subirei, cobrirei a terra; destruirei a cidade e os que nela habitam.

verses.original: עֲל֤וּ הַסּוּסִים֙ וְהִתְהֹלְל֣וּ הָרֶ֔כֶב וְיֵצְא֖וּ הַגִּבּוֹרִ֑ים כּ֤וּשׁ וּפוּט֙ תֹּפְשֵׂ֣י מָגֵ֔ן וְלוּדִ֕ים תֹּפְשֵׂ֖י דֹּ֥רְכֵי קָֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·lū has·sū·sîm wə·hiṯ·hō·lə·lū hā·re·ḵeḇ wə·yê·ṣə·’ū hag·gib·bō·w·rîm kūš ū·p̄ūṭ tō·p̄ə·śê mā·ḡên wə·lū·ḏîm tō·p̄ə·śê dō·rə·ḵê qā·šeṯ
verses.literal: Advance O horses Race furiously O chariots Let the warriors come forth Cush and Put carrying their shields men of Lydia drawing the bow
verses.literalPt: Subi, cavalos, estrondeai, carros; e saiam os valentes: Cus e Pute, que manejam o escudo e os ludins que manejam e entesam o arco.

verses.original: וְֽהַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא לַאדֹנָ֧י יְהוִ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת י֤וֹם נְקָמָה֙ לְהִנָּקֵ֣ם מִצָּרָ֔יו וְאָכְלָ֥ה חֶ֙רֶב֙ וְשָׂ֣בְעָ֔ה וְרָוְתָ֖ה מִדָּמָ֑ם כִּ֣י זֶ֠בַח לַאדֹנָ֨י יְהוִ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת בְּאֶ֥רֶץ צָפ֖וֹן אֶל־ נְהַר־ פְּרָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hay·yō·wm ha·hū la·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ yō·wm nə·qā·māh lə·hin·nā·qêm miṣ·ṣā·rāw wə·’ā·ḵə·lāh ḥe·reḇ wə·śā·ḇə·‘āh wə·rā·wə·ṯāh mid·dā·mām kî ze·ḇaḥ la·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ bə·’e·reṣ ṣā·p̄ō·wn ’el- nə·har- pə·rāṯ
verses.literal: For that day belongs to the Lord GOD of Hosts a day of vengeance against His foes The sword will devour until it is satisfied until it is quenched with their blood For the Lord GOD of Hosts will hold a sacrifice in the land of the north by the River Euphrates
verses.literalPt: Aquele dia, porém, é dia do Senhor, Jeová dos Exércitos, dia de vingança em que se vingará dos seus adversários; a espada devorará e se fartará e se embriagará com o sangue deles. Pois o Senhor, Jeová dos exércitos, tem um sacrifício na terra do norte junto ao rio Eufrates.

verses.original: עֲלִ֤י גִלְעָד֙ וּקְחִ֣י צֳרִ֔י בְּתוּלַ֖ת בַּת־ מִצְרָ֑יִם לַשָּׁוְא֙ הִרְבֵּיתִי רְפֻא֔וֹת תְּעָלָ֖ה אֵ֥ין לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·lî ḡil·‘āḏ ū·qə·ḥî ṣo·rî bə·ṯū·laṯ baṯ- miṣ·rā·yim laš·šāw hir·bē·ṯī rə·p̄u·’ō·wṯ tə·‘ā·lāh ’ên lāḵ
verses.literal: Go up to Gilead for balm O Virgin Daughter of Egypt In vain you try many remedies but for you there is no healing
verses.literalPt: Sobe a Gileade, e toma bálsamo, ó virgem filha do Egito; em vão multiplicas os remédios, não há cura para ti.

verses.original: שָׁמְע֤וּ גוֹיִם֙ קְלוֹנֵ֔ךְ וְצִוְחָתֵ֖ךְ מָלְאָ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־ גִבּ֤וֹר בְּגִבּוֹר֙ כָּשָׁ֔לוּ יַחְדָּ֖יו נָפְל֥וּ שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: šā·mə·‘ū ḡō·w·yim qə·lō·w·nêḵ wə·ṣiw·ḥā·ṯêḵ mā·lə·’āh hā·’ā·reṣ kî- ḡib·bō·wr bə·ḡib·bō·wr kā·šā·lū yaḥ·dāw nā·p̄ə·lū šə·nê·hem
verses.literal: The nations have heard of your shame and your outcry fills the earth because warrior stumbles over warrior and both of them have fallen together
verses.literalPt: As nações já ouviram a tua vergonha, e a terra está cheia do teu clamor; porque o valente tropeçou no valente, ambos juntos caíram.

verses.original: הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ הַנָּבִ֑יא לָב֗וֹא נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל לְהַכּ֖וֹת אֶת־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî lā·ḇō·w nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar me·leḵ bā·ḇel lə·hak·kō·wṯ ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: This is the word that the LORD spoke to Jeremiah the prophet about the coming of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to strike the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: A palavra que Jeová falou ao profeta Jeremias sobre o haver de vir Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia, e haver de ferir a terra do Egito.

verses.original: הַגִּ֤ידוּ בְמִצְרַ֙יִם֙ וְהַשְׁמִ֣יעוּ בְמִגְדּ֔וֹל וְהַשְׁמִ֥יעוּ בְנֹ֖ף וּבְתַחְפַּנְחֵ֑ס אִמְר֗וּ הִתְיַצֵּב֙ וְהָכֵ֣ן לָ֔ךְ כִּֽי־ אָכְלָ֥ה חֶ֖רֶב סְבִיבֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hag·gî·ḏū ḇə·miṣ·ra·yim wə·haš·mî·‘ū ḇə·miḡ·dō·wl wə·haš·mî·‘ū ḇə·nōp̄ ū·ḇə·ṯaḥ·pan·ḥês ’im·rū hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ wə·hā·ḵên lāḵ kî- ’ā·ḵə·lāh ḥe·reḇ sə·ḇî·ḇe·ḵā
verses.literal: Announce it in Egypt and proclaim it in Migdol proclaim it in Memphis and Tahpanhes Take your positions and prepare yourself for the sword devours those around you
verses.literalPt: Anunciai-o no Egito e fazei ouvir isto em Migdol; fazei também ouvir isto em Mênfis e em Tafnes; dizei: Apresenta-te, e prepara-te; pois a espada já devorou ao redor de ti.

verses.original: מַדּ֖וּעַ נִסְחַ֣ף אַבִּירֶ֑יךָ לֹ֣א עָמַ֔ד כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה הֲדָפֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mad·dū·a‘ nis·ḥap̄ ’ab·bî·re·ḵā lō ‘ā·maḏ kî Yah·weh hă·ḏā·p̄ōw
verses.literal: Why have your warriors been laid low They cannot stand for the LORD has thrust them down
verses.literalPt: Por que está derrubado o teu valente? ele não ficou de pé, porque Jeová o empurrou.

verses.original: הִרְבָּ֖ה כּוֹשֵׁ֑ל גַּם־ נָפַ֞ל אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־ רֵעֵ֗הוּ וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ ק֣וּמָה׀ וְנָשֻׁ֣בָה אֶל־ עַמֵּ֗נוּ וְאֶל־ אֶ֙רֶץ֙ מֽוֹלַדְתֵּ֔נוּ מִפְּנֵ֖י חֶ֥רֶב הַיּוֹנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hir·bāh kō·wō·šêl gam- nā·p̄al ’îš ’el- rê·‘ê·hū way·yō·mə·rū qū·māh wə·nā·šu·ḇāh ’el- ‘am·mê·nū wə·’el- ’e·reṣ mō·w·laḏ·tê·nū mip·pə·nê ḥe·reḇ hay·yō·w·nāh
verses.literal: They continue to stumble indeed they have fallen over one another They say Get up Let us return to our people and to the land of our birth away from the sword of the oppressor
verses.literalPt: Jeová fez que muitos caíssem; eles caíram uns sobre os outros, e disseram: Levanta-te, e voltemos para o nosso povo e para a terra onde nascemos, para fugirmos da espada opressora.

verses.original: קָרְא֖וּ שָׁ֑ם פַּרְעֹ֤ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ שָׁא֔וֹן הֶעֱבִ֖יר הַמּוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: qā·rə·’ū šām par·‘ōh me·leḵ- miṣ·ra·yim šā·’ō·wn he·‘ĕ·ḇîr ham·mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: There they will cry out Pharaoh king of Egypt was all noise he has let the appointed time pass him by
verses.literalPt: Clamaram ali: Estrondo é o nome de Faraó, rei do Egito; deixou passar o tempo apontado.

verses.original: חַי־ אָ֙נִי֙ נְאֻם־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמ֑וֹ כִּ֚י כְּתָב֣וֹר בֶּֽהָרִ֔ים וּכְכַרְמֶ֖ל בַּיָּ֥ם יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.transliteration: ḥay- ’ā·nî nə·’um- ham·me·leḵ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šə·mōw kî kə·ṯā·ḇō·wr be·hā·rîm ū·ḵə·ḵar·mel bay·yām yā·ḇō·w
verses.literal: As surely as I live declares the King whose name is the LORD of Hosts there will come one who is like Tabor among the mountains and like Carmel by the sea
verses.literalPt: Pela minha vida, diz o Rei, cujo nome é Jeová dos Exércitos, certamente assim virá o rei do Egito como o Tabor entre os montes e como o Carmelo junto ao mar.

verses.original: כְּלֵ֤י גוֹלָה֙ עֲשִׂ֣י לָ֔ךְ יוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת בַּת־ מִצְרָ֑יִם כִּֽי־ נֹף֙ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֔ה וְנִצְּתָ֖ה מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃ס
verses.transliteration: kə·lê ḡō·w·lāh ‘ă·śî lāḵ yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ baṯ- miṣ·rā·yim kî- nōp̄ lə·šam·māh ṯih·yeh wə·niṣ·ṣə·ṯāh mê·’ên yō·wō·šêḇ
verses.literal: Pack your bags for exile O daughter dwelling in Egypt For Memphis will be laid waste destroyed and uninhabited
verses.literalPt: Ó filha que habitas no Egito, prepara-te para ires ao cativeiro; pois Mênfis se tornará em desolação, e ficará deserta e despovoada.

verses.original: עֶגְלָ֥ה יְפֵֽה־ פִיָּ֖ה מִצְרָ֑יִם קֶ֥רֶץ מִצָּפ֖וֹן בָּ֥א בָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ‘eḡ·lāh yə·p̄êh- p̄î·yāh miṣ·rā·yim qe·reṣ miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn bā ḇā
verses.literal: Egypt is a beautiful heifer but a gadfly from the north is coming against her . . .
verses.literalPt: O Egito é uma novilha mui formosa; mas do norte é vindo um tavão sobre ela.

verses.original: גַּם־ שְׂכִרֶ֤יהָ בְקִרְבָּהּ֙ כְּעֶגְלֵ֣י מַרְבֵּ֔ק כִּֽי־ גַם־ הֵ֧מָּה הִפְנ֛וּ נָ֥סוּ יַחְדָּ֖יו לֹ֣א עָמָ֑דוּ כִּ֣י י֥וֹם אֵידָ֛ם בָּ֥א עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם עֵ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: gam- śə·ḵi·re·hā ḇə·qir·bāh kə·‘eḡ·lê mar·bêq kî- ḡam- hêm·māh hip̄·nū nā·sū yaḥ·dāw lō ‘ā·mā·ḏū kî yō·wm ’ê·ḏām bā ‘ă·lê·hem ‘êṯ pə·qud·dā·ṯām
verses.literal: Even the mercenaries among her are like fattened calves They too will turn back together they will flee they will not stand their ground for the day of calamity is coming upon them the time of their punishment
verses.literalPt: Também os seus soldados mercenários no meio dela são como bezerros cevados; eles igualmente voltaram para trás, fugiram juntos, não ficaram firmes; pois é vindo sobre eles o dia da sua calamidade, o tempo da sua visitação.

verses.original: קוֹלָ֖הּ כַּנָּחָ֣שׁ יֵלֵ֑ךְ כִּֽי־ בְחַ֣יִל יֵלֵ֔כוּ וּבְקַרְדֻּמּוֹת֙ בָּ֣אוּ לָ֔הּ כְּחֹטְבֵ֖י עֵצִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: qō·w·lāh kan·nā·ḥāš yê·lêḵ kî- ḇə·ḥa·yil yê·lê·ḵū ū·ḇə·qar·dum·mō·wṯ bā·’ū lāh kə·ḥō·ṭə·ḇê ‘ê·ṣîm
verses.literal: Egypt will hiss like a fleeing serpent for the enemy will advance in force with axes they will come against her like woodsmen cutting down trees . . .
verses.literalPt: O seu ruído é como o da serpente que foge; à frente dum exército marcharão e virão contra ela com machados como os que cortam lenha.

verses.original: כָּרְת֤וּ יַעְרָהּ֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֖י לֹ֣א יֵֽחָקֵ֑ר כִּ֤י רַבּוּ֙ מֵֽאַרְבֶּ֔ה וְאֵ֥ין לָהֶ֖ם מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kā·rə·ṯū ya‘·rāh nə·’um- Yah·weh kî lō yê·ḥā·qêr kî rab·bū mê·’ar·beh wə·’ên lā·hem mis·pār
verses.literal: They will chop down her forest declares the LORD dense though it may be for they are more numerous than locusts they cannot . . . be counted
verses.literalPt: O bosque, diz Jeová, que de outro modo ninguém o poderá examinar, eles o cortarão; porquanto são mais numerosos do que os gafanhotos, são inumeráveis.

verses.original: הֹבִ֖ישָׁה בַּת־ מִצְרָ֑יִם נִתְּנָ֖ה בְּיַ֥ד עַם־ צָפֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: hō·ḇî·šāh baṯ- miṣ·rā·yim nit·tə·nāh bə·yaḏ ‘am- ṣā·p̄ō·wn
verses.literal: The Daughter of Egypt will be put to shame she will be delivered into the hands of the people of the north
verses.literalPt: Envergonhada será a filha do Egito, entregue nas mãos do povo do norte.

verses.original: אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הִנְנִ֤י פוֹקֵד֙ אֶל־ אָמ֣וֹן מִנֹּ֔א וְעַל־ פַּרְעֹה֙ וְעַל־ מִצְרַ֔יִם וְעַל־ אֱלֹהֶ֖יהָ וְעַל־ מְלָכֶ֑יהָ וְעַ֨ל־ פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְעַ֥ל הַבֹּטְחִ֖ים בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl hin·nî p̄ō·w·qêḏ ’el- ’ā·mō·wn min·nō wə·‘al- par·‘ōh wə·‘al- miṣ·ra·yim wə·‘al- ’ĕ·lō·he·hā wə·‘al- mə·lā·ḵe·hā wə·‘al- par·‘ōh wə·‘al hab·bō·ṭə·ḥîm bōw
verses.literal: The LORD of Hosts the God of Israel says Behold I am about to punish . . . Amon god of Thebes . . . along with Pharaoh Egypt with her gods . . . and kings . . . . . . and those who trust in Pharaoh
verses.literalPt: Jeová dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel, diz: Eis que castigarei a Amom de Nô e a Faraó e ao Egito, juntamente com os seus deuses e com os seus reis, a saber, a Faraó e aos que nele confiam.

verses.original: וּנְתַתִּ֗ים בְּיַד֙ מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י נַפְשָׁ֔ם וּבְיַ֛ד נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל וּבְיַד־ עֲבָדָ֑יו וְאַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֛ן תִּשְׁכֹּ֥ן כִּֽימֵי־ קֶ֖דֶם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·ṯat·tîm bə·yaḏ mə·ḇaq·šê nap̄·šām ū·ḇə·yaḏ nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel ū·ḇə·yaḏ- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw wə·’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên tiš·kōn kî·mê- qe·ḏem nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will deliver them into the hands of those who seek their lives . . . of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon . . . and his officers But after this Egypt will be inhabited as in days of old declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Entregá-los-ei nas mãos dos que procuram tirar-lhes a vida, e nas mãos de Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia, e nas mãos dos seus servos: e depois será habitada, como nos dias antigos, diz Jeová.

verses.original: וְ֠אַתָּה אַל־ תִּירָ֞א עַבְדִּ֤י יַֽעֲקֹב֙ וְאַל־ תֵּחַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֠י הִנְנִ֤י מוֹשִֽׁעֲךָ֙ מֵֽרָח֔וֹק וְאֶֽת־ זַרְעֲךָ֖ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ שִׁבְיָ֑ם וְשָׁ֧ב יַעֲק֛וֹב וְשָׁקַ֥ט וְשַׁאֲנַ֖ן וְאֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ’al- tî·rā ‘aḇ·dî ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·’al- tê·ḥaṯ yiś·rā·’êl kî hin·nî mō·wō·ši·‘ă·ḵā mê·rā·ḥō·wq wə·’eṯ- zar·‘ă·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ šiḇ·yām wə·šāḇ ya·‘ă·qō·wḇ wə·šā·qaṭ wə·ša·’ă·nan wə·’ên ma·ḥă·rîḏ
verses.literal: But you O Jacob My servant do not be afraid and do not be dismayed O Israel For I will surely save you out of a distant place your descendants from the land of their captivity Jacob will return to quiet and ease with no one to make him afraid
verses.literalPt: Mas tu não tenhas medo, servo meu Jacó, nem te espantes, Israel; porque eu te livrarei de terras remotas e da terra do seu cativeiro a tua linhagem; voltará Jacó, e ficará tranquilo e sossegado, e ninguém o amedrontará.

verses.original: אַ֠תָּה אַל־ תִּירָ֞א עַבְדִּ֤י יַֽעֲקֹב֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י אִתְּךָ֖ אָ֑נִי כִּי֩ אֶעֱשֶׂ֨ה כָלָ֜ה בְּכָֽל־ הַגּוֹיִ֣ם׀ אֲשֶׁ֧ר הִדַּחְתִּ֣יךָ שָׁ֗מָּה וְאֹֽתְךָ֙ לֹא־ אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה כָלָ֔ה וְיִסַּרְתִּ֙יךָ֙ לַמִּשְׁפָּ֔ט וְנַקֵּ֖ה לֹ֥א אֲנַקֶּֽךָּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh ’al- tî·rā ‘aḇ·dî ya·‘ă·qōḇ nə·’um- Yah·weh kî ’it·tə·ḵā ’ā·nî kî ’e·‘ĕ·śeh ḵā·lāh bə·ḵāl hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer hid·daḥ·tî·ḵā šām·māh wə·’ō·ṯə·ḵā lō- ’e·‘ĕ·śeh ḵā·lāh wə·yis·sar·tî·ḵā lam·miš·pāṭ wə·naq·qêh lō ’ă·naq·qe·kā
verses.literal: And you My servant Jacob do not be afraid declares the LORD for I am with you Though I will completely destroy all the nations to which I have banished you . . . I will not completely destroy you . . . Yet I will discipline you justly and will by no means leave you unpunished . . .
verses.literalPt: Tu não tenhas medo, servo meu Jacó; porque eu sou contigo. Pois destruirei totalmente todas as nações para onde te arrojei. A ti, porém, não te destruirei de todo, mas castigar-te-ei com juízo, e de maneira alguma te terei por inocente.
